Neha — good questions. Short answers and a suggested fill template below.

1) Rationale content: keep the paragraph qualitative (customer signal, PO timeline, decision committee name), and put ARR/TCV into the numeric column on the sheet. That keeps the leadership slide concise but preserves numbers for finance reconciliation.

2) Signed MSA but no PO = Commit - contingent. Treat as commit only if there's a PO or a written PO timeline with a named approver. Add "MSA-only" to column H so finance can filter.

Suggested paragraph format (one line each):
- Buyer & title; short signal (e.g., "confirmed budget for X product, POC scheduled 9/7"); closing condition (PO expected by 9/3) — 2–3 sentences.

I'll update leadership_onepager.md with that example and push to the sheet. Thanks for taking the manager review pass on Tue.
